requirements.requirement: Use actual original video pixels as plot-form authority. Structural timber enclosures from old art boards are distinct and must not replace the ground-pad designs.

Storage: nearly ground-flush dark warm gray/brown rounded rectangle, thin continuous light tan rim, centered resource pictogram, stock on the same footprint. No posts, rails, ropes, raised foundation, stone ring, billboard or new building.

Buy/action: flat warm brown square/rounded-square with exactly four separated white rounded corner brackets, white observed action symbol and source-style cost field. No full continuous storage border, freestanding signs or pedestals.
Active work zone: segmented rectangular outline, green when active and white idle, unfilled interior; not the same design as a filled green material-payment marker.

One-time build/upgrade may remove its marker after payment and installation. Repeatable axe upgrades return/remain available. Do not show permanent completed green checkmark pads as a universal result.

Every turnaround has8 clockwise views0,45,90,135,180,225,270,315 in4x2, fixed approx35-degree elevation sufficient for top readability; all fixed graphics/stock rotate with the plot, no camera-facing billboard icons or repeated opposite diagonals. Stable silhouette, stock count, landmarks and palette.

Keep stylized polished Havenline resource appearances from prior33; fixed source-derived plot design. New resource pictograms/storage variants are labelled proposals, not previously existing canonical types.
Costs visible in source are reference display examples only. No invented Havenline prices, capacities, quantities, unlock tiers, mechanics or durations. Stock amounts shown are illustrative.
State plates must preserve footprint and distinguish empty/partial/stocked, payment-active, marker removal, repeatable availability, and active outline. No motion or runtime certification.

Independent critic inspects actual full sheets and useful closeups, source alignment and use states. Strictly above9.0 with all mandatory checks; preserve rejected revisions and perform targeted repair/retest.

Preserve all33 approved resource PNGs byte-identically. Save final plot images, exact prompts, source/state mapping, references and review evidence to a new GitHub art-only folder; package final downloads.

coverage_rule: All33 existing resources mapped to a shared physical pad vocabulary; the fifteen stocked sheets are representative visual types.
